title: Definitely worth it! Marta was exceptional!
text: Marta our tour guide was amazing. Communication was informative and everything happened flawlessly.  Marta is such a wonderful person whose knowledge of the area made our tour all the more enjoyable.  Our whole family felt special and looked after.  We spent have to worry about a thing.  I would highly recommend her.
author: KAREN W

title: Hands down top tour we did in our 2 weeks in Spain
text: An absolute fantastic and wonderful day. It’s so hard to describe the day Marta provided for us. She was so kind and met us at an easy meeting point to navigate the metro since we didn’t know how to in Spain. She was so knowledgeable of the area. Montserrat was an incredible experience. We took this rail car to the top of the mountain where she showed us the Basilica and where the current monks live. There was a mass that we were able to join and pray.. which was lovely. We then walked down the trail to the cave where historians say a shepherd boy found the statue of the Virgin Mary in the yea
author: Rebecca_R

title: Marta for Monserrat
text: Marta was excellent and her knowledge really helped us understand the history and tradition behind Monserrat.
author: Thomas_L

title: The Black Madonna Experience at Montserrat
text: Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and engaging. She went out of her way to ensure we were able to learn everything about the history of the monastery and the Black Madonna! We enjoyed the tour and our time with Marta!
author: Inajo_C

title: A great day at Montserrat!
text:
Start to finish, Marta was sharing insight and comfortably engaging, friendly conversation, not teaching; she is very knowledgeable about history and context.
Every detail, logistic, arrangement etc was anticipated and seamless…
author: Craig_P

title: Marvelous experience!
text:
Do not miss it!

Adri and Ori were wonderful guides. They explained to us the history of Barcelona and Montserrat.  They gave us Very interesting facts plus they were funny.
I loved the trip, the sightseeing and the Mel and mato.
Amazing place and people. Make it a part of your itinerary. Booking the trip with trip advisor was convenient.
author: Noumira

title: Amazing day in Montserrat
text: Marta was a great guide, she made the trip flexible for our young kids. We were able to see the boys choir, and we loved the cable car ride up the mountain.
author: Echo_T

title: We totally enjoyed the experience. We learned a great deal about the culture.Marya was awesome.  An Enjoyable Experience
text: Wonderful experience, learned a lot about the culture. Saw a great deal of the surrounding areas.  Marta was amazing. I would recommend to visitors, a must see.
author: Twarina D

title: Beautiful day at Montserrat!
text: Our guide Marta was amazing, very knowledgeable & engaging.  When the monorail was not working she made sure we were able to attend other attractions at the site.  We were fortunate that the weather was crystal clear so we could see Barcelona. We all enjoyed the breathtaking views from Montserrat!
author: DCurrigan

title: A must see in Barcelona
text: A wonderful mountain view. Our guide Anna was so knowledgeable and knew exactly how to direct us the the most important highlights of the venue. Everything was organised nicely from Barcelona to Monserrat and back to Barcelona again just on time. Thank you
author: ChrisTongua
